purpose: Teach: 生き残る/内陸/空襲/徹し/元素/王室/画一/誇張

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界で、本気で、絶対、生き残る、力、絶対、磨いていけ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、社員、皆、本気で、頑張れ、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Our company needs to survive in this industry with real strength. I'm asking all of you—polish your skills, show real commitment. Absolutely.
lines.style: Measured, decisive opening. Words land with quiet weight. Steady eye contact. The tone of a man who speaks rarely but when he does, people listen. No theatrics—just conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。内陸の市場、本気で、絶対、開拓してまいります、本気で、新規事業、絶対、進めます、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. We will open up the inland markets with genuine effort. We're advancing into new business areas. I'm truly grateful for the opportunity, sir.
lines.style: Formal, respectful cadence. Slightly forward-leaning posture in the voice. Earnest—not performing, but showing attentiveness. Each phrase carefully placed, like setting stones.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者、戦時、本気で、空襲を、絶対、生き延びた、強い人物、本気で、お母さんから、絶対、聞いている、本気で、本当に、絶対、誇り。
lines.en: The founder survived air raids during the war—he was a strong man. My mother told me about him. That's something I'm genuinely proud of.
lines.style: Reflective, almost distant. Voice softens slightly. Speaking to a memory as much as to the present moment. Pause before the final sentence—weight of inheritance. Quiet dignity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、信念を、絶対、徹した働き方、絶対、当社の伝統です、本気で、本当に、感謝、しております、絶対、本気、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes. Our employees work with unwavering belief—that dedication to principles is part of our tradition. I'm deeply grateful for that legacy.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Voice carries the awareness of speaking about something inherited and sacred. Not rushed. Respect infuses each phrase. Slight emphasis on 'tradition' like honoring something beyond himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品、本気で、絶対、最新の元素、技術、絶対、活用しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、業界、絶対、リードしていけ、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Use the latest technology and materials in the new products. I'm asking you to lead the industry. We have to set the standard.
lines.style: Sharper than before. Clear instruction, no ambiguity. Forward momentum in the delivery. 'Lead the industry' lands with emphasis—not a suggestion but a direction. Chin raised slightly in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。王室御用達、本気で、絶対、目指したいですね、本気で、当社、ブランド、絶対、上がりますね、本気で、本当に、感謝、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. That's something I'd like to aspire to—becoming a royal warrant holder. Our brand reputation will rise with that achievement.
lines.style: Brightened tone, more energized than previous responses. Genuine enthusiasm underneath the formality. Leaning slightly into possibility. The voice of someone seeing a path forward. Confident but not cocky.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 画一的な、本気で、絶対、サービス、避けろ、本気で、お客様、本気で、絶対、個別対応、徹底だ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Avoid one-size-fits-all service. Every customer deserves individual attention. That's non-negotiable. I'm counting on you to make it happen.
lines.style: Declarative, almost stern. Each phrase a separate beat. 'Individual attention' emphasized—this is the heart of it. Steady, uncompromising. The voice of someone who has thought about this deeply and expects it done right.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告、本気で、絶対、誇張、避けるよう、社員、徹底させております、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、頑張ります、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Our advertising avoids exaggeration—we've made sure all staff understand that standard. I'm grateful for your guidance, and we'll continue pushing forward.
lines.style: Closing statement, slightly more relaxed than the earlier responses. Acknowledgment of direction received. Voice settles into a steady rhythm. Confident without arrogance. Readiness in the final phrase—prepared for what comes next.
